product_overview: RakeFlow is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for poker clubs to manage cash game sessions, tournaments, player transactions, rake collection and automated financial distribution with real-time auditing and KPI reporting.
core_goals: Provide multi-tenant isolation so each club only accesses its own players, sessions, transactions and rules
Automate cash game and tournament lifecycles, including precise rake calculation and rule-driven distribution
Enable accurate real-time auditing and session-closing validation to eliminate spreadsheet errors
Offer player and transaction management with controlled editing while sessions are open
Expose actionable KPIs and distributions (weekly/monthly) to help clubs meet financial goals

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Club onboarding, JWT login, and account deletion (tenant lifecycle and auth dependency for all protected routes).
user_flows: POST /auth/register with {name,email,password} -> Receive 201 with message, club_id, email -> POST /auth/login with {username: email, password} -> Receive 200 with access_token and token_type
POST /auth/register with an already-registered email -> Receive 400 Email already registered
POST /auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Invalid credentials
POST /auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> DELETE /me/delete-account with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 message (account and all club data deleted)
DELETE /me/delete-account without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Player Management
features.description: Create and list players scoped to the authenticated club (validation on name length and trimming).
user_flows: POST /auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /players/ with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {name, phone} -> Receive 200 Player -> GET /players/ with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 Player[]
POST /players/ with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {name: "  ", phone} (name trimmed to empty) -> Receive 400 Name length validation error
GET /players/ without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Session Management
features.description: Open, monitor, audit, and close cash game sessions with distribution rules and pre-close validation.
user_flows: POST /auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /sessions/ with Authorization: Bearer <token> and empty body -> Receive 200 Session (new open session) -> GET /sessions/active with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 Session (active session)

POST /sessions/{session_id}/close with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {declared_rake_cash, declared_jackpot_cash, force_close: false} -> Receive 200 CloseResult when declared cash matches expected
GET /sessions/{session_id}/audit with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 AuditResponse (pre-close financial report)
POST /sessions/ with Authorization: Bearer <token> when another open session exists -> Receive 409 Conflict (one open session limit)

POST /sessions/{session_id}/close with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {declared_rake_cash, declared_jackpot_cash, force_close: false} where declared totals mismatch expected -> Receive 409 Mismatch (discrepancy detected)
DELETE /sessions/{session_id} without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Transaction Management
features.description: Record buy-ins, cashouts, spends, tips, bonuses and manage transaction edits/deletes while session is open.
user_flows: POST /auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /transactions/ with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {player_id, session_id, amount: 100, method: "CASH"} -> Receive 200 Transaction -> GET /transactions/{session_id} with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 Transaction[]
POST /transactions/bonus with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {player_id, session_id, amount: 50} -> Receive 200 Transaction
POST /transactions/ with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {player_id, session_id, amount: 0, method: "CASH"} -> Receive 400 Amount must be > 0
PUT /transactions/{transaction_id} with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {amount: 150} on a transaction belonging to a closed session -> Receive 400 Editing not allowed on closed session
DELETE /transactions/{transaction_id} without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Tournament Management
features.description: Create tournaments, register players (buyins, tips), handle rebuys/add-ons, finalize winners and distribute prizes per payout structure.
user_flows: POST /auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /tournaments/ with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {name, buyin_amount, rake_percentage, payout_structure} -> Receive 200 Tournament -> POST /tournaments/{tournament_id}/register with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {player_id, pay_buyin: true, pay_tip: false} -> Receive 200 TournamentPlayer

POST /tournaments/{tournament_id}/rebuy with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {player_id, type: "single"} -> Receive 200 TournamentPlayer -> POST /tournaments/{tournament_id}/finalize with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {winners: [{rank:1,player_id:42}, {rank:2,player_id:8}]} -> Receive 200 Tournament (prizes assigned) -> POST /tournaments/{tournament_id}/end with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 Tournament (marked finished)
POST /tournaments/ with Authorization: Bearer <token> when another active tournament exists -> Receive 409 Conflict (only one active tournament allowed)
POST /tournaments/{tournament_id}/register with Authorization: Bearer <token> and invalid player_id -> Receive 400 Invalid player reference

features.name: Statistics
features.description: Dashboard KPIs, rankings, weekly distributions, monthly quota progress and jackpot tracking scoped to the authenticated club.
user_flows: POST /auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> GET /stats/dashboard with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 DashboardStats -> GET /stats/rankings with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 Rankings
GET /stats/jackpot-global with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with total_jackpot number
GET /stats/dashboard with an expired or invalid token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
GET /stats/weekly-distribution with Authorization: Bearer <token> and date range params -> Receive 200 WeeklyDistribution

features.name: Configuration
features.description: Initial setup wizard and management of rake distribution rules (fixed, quota, percentage) applied at session close.
user_flows: POST /auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /config/initial-setup with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {monthly_goal, partners: [{name, percentage}]} -> Receive 200 message -> GET /config/distribution with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 DistributionRule[]
POST /config/distribution with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body [DistributionRuleCreate...] -> Receive 200 DistributionRule[] (rules overwritten)
POST /config/distribution with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body containing invalid percentages (sum > 100) -> Receive 400 Validation error
GET /config/distribution without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: History
features.description: Unified chronological view of all closed sessions and completed tournaments for auditing and record-keeping.
user_flows: POST /auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> GET /history/ with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 HistoryItem[] (chronological list with financials)
GET /history/ without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
